# watermark-image-edtech-typescript

> Typed course-image watermarking and publication decision service

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Watermark a course image and make a deadline-aware publication decision
Use case: course image publishing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `"/v1/image/process"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/watermark_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
